title.english: A Horny Money World: legendary night
title.native: A Horny Money World ~伝説の夜~
title.romaji: A Horny Money World: Densetsu no Yoru

61603.description:
Aoi Ashito’s game has now earned him a spot on the A team, but he is quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

61607.description:
After the Li Tianchen case comes to a close, peace appears to return to Time Photo Studio—until the disappearance of Xia Fei draws everyone back into a web of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's newfound abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang begin uncovering the truth behind the mysterious Bahati fire.

As the investigation deepens, hidden connections emerge between the case and Cheng Xiaoshi's parents. Meanwhile, Liu Xiao, a member of a mysterious organization, sets his own plans in motion, while the intervention of Inspector Jae introduces new uncertainties. As secrets buried in the past resurface, the search for truth becomes more dangerous than ever.

(Source: bilibili, translated)

title.native: 时光代理人 第三季 Part One

61608.description:
Meisuke "Nube" Nueno, a teacher at Doumori Elementary School and expert in the occult, finds it increasingly difficult to protect his students against dark forces. After one of his students is sent to a parallel world, Nube encounters an unusual spirit that sends him back in time to change one regretful event.

Although Nube manages to fix the situation, this succession of unlikely events suggests that a more serious menace may be threatening the peace of Doumori. To protect everyone he holds dear, Nube will have to overcome the demons of his past and uncover the nature of the looming supernatural danger.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

title.english: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube (2025) Part 2
title.native: 地獄先生ぬ～べ～ (2025) 第2クール

61609.description: Acting pretentious is his hobby! Being the ultimate rich player, he’s used to spending “expenses” around others on the down-low, having the most extravagant equipment and armor. In the gaming world, there's nothing that can't be solved with money!

61613.description:
A fallen prince unexpectedly obtains an ancient divine sword, fights his way through the three realms, and ultimately rises to godhood!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

61615.description:
A scientific expedition from Blue Star discovered a strange humanoid corpse exposed in a vacuum on the planet Minglong. The expedition brought it back to Blue Star for research, but unexpectedly, they also brought disaster. The energy emanating from the humanoid corpse caused the entire Blue Star biosphere to enter a state of supernatural evolution. Fortunately, the humans on Blue Star were also within the biosphere and entered the supernatural evolutionary sequence, successively evolving into: Human-level, Earth-level, and Celestial-level evolvers. The seven most powerful Celestial-level evolvers were known as the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​protecting Hanxia in this chaotic world fraught with calamities. The anomalies on Blue Star attracted the attention of the Great Yu Empire, which ruled this star field. The Great Yu Empire believed that these anomalies might be related to a fugitive they were hunting. Therefore, taking advantage of the emergence of the Tenth Academy of the Starry Sky, they issued an academy trial, attracting a large number of students from combat academies to Blue Star under the guise of trials to find the fugitive and hone their new blood. On Blue Star, a young man named Lu Yin lies in hiding. He is unaware of his identity and origins; his earliest memories are of a bloody massacre, leaving him alone and stranded on Blue Star. As Blue Star undergoes a dramatic transformation, he realizes this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. He needs a clean new identity to return to that dangerous starry sea and seek revenge for the blood debts of the past. Thus, Lu Yin, the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​students of the Great Yu Empire, and various other forces enter the scene. On Blue Star, an unprecedented evolution and hunt is about to begin.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

61616.description:
An airport bombing terror attack occurs in the frigid Roviet Union.
The unexpected suspect is Lupin III.
However, the "other Lupin" cornered by Zenigata claims his innocence.
Zenigata, a man of justice, finds himself confronted by the mysterious "fake Lupin."
A national conspiracy, the truth behind the bombing, and the intersection of two Lupins -- Zenigata's beliefs are put to the test.

The most rugged, passionate and melancholy buddy action movie in the series' history begins!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

title.english: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata and the Two Lupins
title.native: LUPIN THE IIIRD 銭形と2人のルパン
title.romaji: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata to Futari no Lupin

61617.description:
After a botched robbery attempt leads to their banishment, a clumsy pig demon and his toad companion hatch an ambitious scheme: impersonate the legendary monk Tang San Zang and his disciples to claim the glory of the sacred scrolls. Recruiting a chatterbox weasel and a cowardly gorilla to complete their ragtag troupe, the quartet embarks on a chaotic journey across a world filled with dangerous rivals and mistaken identities. Their charade takes a perilous turn when they stumble into the path of a sinister adversary plotting to consume the monk for immortality. Forced to confront their own limitations, the group must decide if they are content playing pretend or if they possess the true mettle of heroes.

(Source: Viki)

title.romaji: Lang Lang Shan Xiao Yao Guai

61618.description:
In a conspiracy, the supreme leader of the martial arts world, Dao Zong, was killed, and the leaders of various gangs were either dead or imprisoned, and the martial arts world was in chaos. In order to rebuild the order of the martial arts world, Yan Jiyu, the leader of Changfeng Pavilion, sent messengers to various sects, intending to establish a new "righteous" martial arts world headed by him. However, at this time, the fledgling Yang Ren was entrusted to deliver a letter left by Dao Zong. Along the way, he was surrounded by powerful enemies and extremely dangerous, but he relied on his passion and chivalry to constantly break through himself and defeat his opponents.

While his martial arts skills were advancing rapidly, he also met a group of chivalrous and righteous people. What should the martial arts world be like? Yang Ren couldn't answer, but he knew it was definitely not what Yan Jiyu said. Yang Ren raised a big banner: "Chengfeng Gang", and quickly gathered people from the martial arts world who opposed Yan Jiyu. The war has begun, and no one can stay out of it. After the death of Dao Zong, the martial arts world, which had been divided for a long time, will be stitched together again with the rise of the new generation of Dao Zong.

(Source: iQIYI)

61619.description:
In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

(Source: iQ)

61621.description:
Yun Wangshu's wedding was meant to be the happiest day of her life, but a brutal conspiracy turned it into a nightmare, slaughtering her entire clan. After a narrow escape, she made a desperate deal with the Silent Court. Now, sixty years later, reborn as the merciless Xihe, she's ready to make her enemies bleed for everything they took from her.

(Source: Youku International Website)
synonyms: คราสมายา หวนสู่สังหาร

61622.description:
In a quiet village, a young boy named Duanmu Yeyu was once saved by the elite “Hell Hunters” of Ember City. Deeply inspired by these heroes, he vowed to one day become a Hell Hunter himself. As he boards a bus to Ember City to chase his dream, Yeyu is unknowingly swept into a storm of chaos. The main antagonist, Lucifer, sends a bioengineered operative named MIKO-Taiyi to infiltrate Ember City and steal classified data. During a fierce battle with the Hell Hunters, Taiyi is severely injured and falls unconscious. Yeyu stumbles upon Taiyi and, unaware of Taiyi's identity, brings Taiyi back to the Hell Hunters’ base for treatment. In the process, Yeyu unintentionally takes a critical mission device from Taiyi. As Yeyu begins his long-awaited trial to join the Hell Hunters, his innocent act sets off a chain reaction. Taiyi, desperate to avoid detection by Ember City forces, must covertly approach Yeyu and retrieve the device. Meanwhile, Lucifer dispatches tens of thousands of minions to locate the missing Taiyi. Thus begins a citywide conflict, sparked by a small act of kindness, that threatens to become a battle for Ember City’s very survival.

(Source: iQIYI)
synonyms: เงาแค้นสองเส้นทาง

61625.description:
A hundred years ago, immortal Tian Quan kills the Mirage Lord in a battle, and the Mirage Spirit disappears from the land of Cangshuo. However, Tian Quan's soul becomes incomplete and she loses the memory of the battle.
</br></br>
After the battle, Tian Quan goes down to the mortal world to work on the land of Cangshuo and adopts the immortal pet bird Li Xiao. Li Xiao quickly transforms into human form, and Tian Quan is moved by how similar Li Xiao’s appearance and behavior are to her former lover Shao Weili. Li Xiao is born with the ability to identify hundreds of herbs, and he goes out to treat illnesses and save people on Tian Quan's behalf. After Tian Quan realizes that Li Xiao has not returned home for days, she goes to Luoyi Town to look for him. To her surprise, all the people in Luoyi Town are killed and the Mirage Spirit has re-appeared.
</br></br>
Tian Quan and Li Xiao work together to fight against the Mirage and resolves the town’s crisis. As the Tian Quan regains her chaotic memories, she discovers that there is some probable connection between her deceased lover Shao Weili, Li Xiao, and the Mirage she killed...
</br></br>
(Source: iQIYI)
synonyms: พันธะสวรรค์

61627.description:
Kyouko brags about being scouted by her childhood friend Souji's favorite gravure idol. Souji gets angry and rejects her, but one day, he receives a video. It shows Kyouko in a risque swimsuit, taking on her first gravure shoot! In the video, she is at the mercy of the staff, and eventually she moans while saying Souji's name, being defiled by the hands of a stranger. What will Souji think of this...!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

61628.description:
Since the shocking gravure photo shoot, Kyouko has become strangely seductive, and Souji has also changed... The two have become lovers, and one day Souji invites his friend Segawa to Kyouko's house for study purposes, but Souji sneaks out saying he has something to do. When they are alone, Kyouko actively invites Segawa out! Souji spies on Kyouko and Segawa getting wild with a hidden camera in the room...?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

61629.description:
Music video directed by RIRI Yamashita for the song MONSTER by Ninomae Inanis, Ouro Kronii, Shiori Novella and Gigi Murin.

Note: This song serves as the the theme song for ENigmatic Recollection Chapter 2, The Chains of Fate!

61634.description:
In the game, the server's top swordsman, Xiao Wujin, and the most wanted female outlaw, Tao Zhiyaoyao, first crossed paths as rivals. In real life, campus heartthrob Xiao He of Dongchuan University and freshman Shen Xin met through a collegiate esports tournament and quickly grew close. Together with their friend Yang Yao, they formed a team and fought their way through every challenge, determined to claim the championship. Along the way, Xiao He and Shen Xin healed and inspired one another, moving forward hand in hand in pursuit of their dreams. With a little help from their friends Yang Yao and Xiang Nan, what kind of romance will blossom between them?

(Source: iQ)

61637.description:
Having spent his childhood in the slums, Hajime Shinonome desperately sought strength to survive.

Now, he enjoys a peaceful and carefree life as a resident adventurer of the Komai Village.

One day, during a quest, he ventured into a dungeon and finds a young girl being partially eaten by a weakest kind of monster, a slime!

The girl's name was Lirui. Having been abandoned by her parents, she had no place to go and entered the dungeon alone in order to stay alive. Hajime couldn't just leave her there, so he took her back to the village to live with him!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Everyday of the 29 years old single person adventurer.
The Everyday Life of a 29-Year Old Middling Adventurer
The Daily Life of a Single 29-Year-Old Adventurer
ชีวิตประจำวันของนักผจญภัยโสดวัย 29

title.english: An Adventurer’s Daily Grind at Age 29

61640.description:
The Forbidden City is home to six cats with a secret mission: protect the memories held within China’s cultural relics. When the destructive force known as Black Owl threatens Wuhua, the world within those relics, the six guardians enter its realm to fight back. Armed with courage and teamwork, these feline guardians must defeat Black Owl before he erases the history they swore to protect.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: 紫禁・御猫房〜紫禁城猫警備室〜

61642.description:
Yi Feng traveled to the Xianjiang Continent. Since he was born without spiritual roots, he could only survive by relying on the "essential life skills" given by the system. Little did he know that in the eyes of those practitioners, his strength was already at the god level, and his every move affected the entire pattern of the Xianjiang Continent. Yi Feng easily resolved many crises without knowing it, which also brought about many passionate and hilarious scenes, and brought new opportunities and choices to the people living on this continent.

(Source: iQIYI, Google translated)

61649.description:
Taoist Cui accidentally released the treasure-gathering golden toad in order to read the heavenly book. The golden toad coveted the prosperity of the human world and reincarnated as a human, Dou Zhanlong. In order to avoid the heavenly calamity, the golden toad tore the three souls and seven spirits in Dou Zhanlong's spiritual cavity, creating nine clones, which fell into nine places respectively. The nine Dou Zhanlongs were in different parallel time and space, and each death gave rise to a new clone. They experienced "nine deaths and thirteen disasters" in total. Our story starts with the first Dou Zhanlong.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

61650.description: We follow the epic journey of three war mercenaries across three continents, more than a dozen countries, and the realm of the gods.

61657.description:
Lin Fan, who was born in a noble family in Dalin County, was originally a peerless genius who was awarded the Tianjiao Order, but his martial soul was taken away by his fiancée, and he became a waste. When a mysterious demon parasitized Lin Fan and reactivated his abandoned martial soul, making him a rare dual martial soul physique, Lin Fan officially embarked on the road to rise, from a small county town to the heavens and the worlds.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

61663.description:
Yoi Takiguchi has long legs, a deep voice, and a handsome face…in other words, Yoi is such a good-looking guy that most people don’t notice or care that she is, in fact, a girl. Indeed, she’s had the nickname “Prince” for as long as she can remember. That is, until she met Ichimura-senpai…the only person who really seemed to see her for herself. To her surprise, she’s not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that). The story of the two high school princes starts here!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: เมื่อสาวหล่อขอมีรัก

61667.description:
Born in Asuka Village, Sakichi was discriminated against by the villagers because of his appearance. One day, Sakichi discovered Reiko being held captive in a large mansion. Sakichi infiltrates the mansion to rescue her, only to find it to be a trick mansion filled with various traps and mazes.

(Source: Kanazawa Film Fest 2025 Website, translated)

Note: Production began in 1992 following the completion of MIDORI, with Harada working on the film single-handedly and funding it himself.
synonyms: 極彩色肉筆絵巻 座敷牢

61671.description: Music video for the "superhuman share house story" Charisma project's song Charisma Jamboree, also the title of their 2nd album.

title.native: カリスマジャンボリー

61672.description:
Zero crash-lands on the war-torn planet Amatera with no memories and no idea who she is. Amidst a brutal conflict between the local resistance and the imperial Gevuran forces, she meets Ring, a charismatic young leader fighting to save the world. As Zero’s identity slowly awakens, she discovers she’s no ordinary girl—she’s a cosmic being known as Galverse, a key to something far greater than any one planet.

Notes:
• The project was initially funded through a digital art initiative connected to the Galverse NFT collection.
• The entry is currently restricted from being added to favorites due to score and vote brigading by several fake sockpuppet accounts associated with the project.

61677.description: Music video for the "superhuman share house story" Charisma project's song Charisma in Da House, included in their 2nd album, Charisma Jamboree.

title.native: カリスマ・イン・ダ・ハウス

61686.description:
“I will become the world’s most wonderful maid!”

With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count’s family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Ko)! streamed a week in advance of the TV broadcast on dAnimeStore and ABEMA beginning June 24th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 1st, 2026.

title.english: Heroine? Saint? No, I’m an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
title.native: ヒロイン？聖女？いいえ、オールワークスメイドです（誇）！
title.romaji: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Ko)!

61687.description:
Bertia is reincarnated into her favorite otome game—not as the heroine, but as the villainess engaged to the perfect Crown Prince Cecil! Fully aware that her role is to sabotage his future romance, she’s determined to bloom as a wicked flower and wither away according to the story. But no matter how hard she tries to scheme, her “evil” plans only make her more endearing!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. was streamed 3 days in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video, and Crunchyroll beginning April 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on April 6, 2026.
synonyms: Observation Records of My Fiancée: The Misadventures of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess
บันทึกสังเกตการณ์คู่หมั้นผู้ประกาศตัวเป็นนางร้าย

title.english: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
title.native: 自称悪役令嬢な婚約者の観察記録。
title.romaji: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku.

61694.description:
Akane Tsuda (28), working at a major electronics manufacturer, impulsively buys something while drunk—something that guarantees a felony just for possession!? It was Nadeshiko, an illegally manufactured adult romance android!? Akane finds herself at Nadeshiko's mercy, but despite being toyed with, she's drawn to Nadeshiko's various impressive skills...? The single office lady and the android begin their naughty cohabitation life together!!

(Source: OceanVeil)
synonyms: Does it Count if You Lose Your Virginity to an Android?

title.english: Does it Count if You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
title.native: アンドロイドは経験人数に入りますか？？
title.romaji: Android wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka??

61699.description:
Carefree, coquettish, and capricious, Tamala is the cutest girl-cat in dystopian Cat Tokyo, year 2030—or at any other point in the time/space continuum. She has randomly invited herself along on her detective friend Michelangelo’s missing-person investigation. It seems the case is one of seven sudden vanishings in an astronomical pattern across Cat Japan that occurred at the exact same moment one night. Their search leads ever deeper into a mystery with ancient, occult roots and apocalyptic implications—and threads leading to Tamala herself. Shadowed by a covert agent of the Catty & Co. consortium, she may in fact be the greatest enigma. Indolent ingénue? Megacorporate mascot? Mythic messiah, or manifestation of cosmic malevolence? Anyhow, wow—she sure is a great dancer!

(Source: Fantasia Festival Website)

title.romaji: TAMALA 2030: a punk cat in dark
